page.layout: One scan: a colour calibration target (X-Rite ColorChecker Classic) lying on a black surface, with a transparent plastic ADOX ruler at the left edge. No printed book page is visible.
page.notes: No book text is printed on this scan. The visible printed items are the ruler scale (0 to 20 cm, mm scale on the target), the ADOX logo with "SYSTEM" and "Patent Nr 18353-0001" on the ruler, the "ColorChecker CLASSIC" and "x-rite" marks on the target, and a small "Patent Nr 18353-0001" line at the far left edge. These are digitisation or equipment markings, not book text, and are therefore left out. Nothing else is transcribable.
